import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    static String toString(BigInteger num) {
        return num.toString();
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        int cur, until;
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2 = new ArrayList<>();

        // brute recursive function
        class Brute {
            void brute(int pos, int[] curPtr, List<Integer> rem, int until) {
                if (pos == until) {
                    rem.add(curPtr[0]);
                    return;
                }
                int oldcur = curPtr[0];
                for (int t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
                    brute(pos + 1, curPtr, rem, until);
                    curPtr[0] += variables.get(pos);
                    if (curPtr[0] >= mod) curPtr[0] -= mod;
                }
                curPtr[0] = oldcur;
            }
        }

        Brute br = new Brute();
        cur = base;
        until = variables.size() / 2;
        int[] curPtr = new int[]{cur};
        br.brute(0, curPtr, rem1, until);

        rem2 = new ArrayList<>(rem1);
        rem1.clear();
        curPtr[0] = 0;
        until = variables.size();
        br.brute(variables.size() / 2, curPtr, rem1, until);

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2) totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= mod) j--;
            long add = a * (long) rem2.size() + totalrsum - (rem2.size() - 1 - j) * (long) mod;
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(add));
        }
    }

    static long countWithPrefix(String s, long n, String nStr) {
        long ans = 0;
        long sVal = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray()) sVal = 10 * sVal + (ch - '0');

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= nStr.length(); len++) {
            if (len < nStr.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int t = s.compareTo(nStr.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (t < 0) {
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (t == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - sVal * pw10[nStr.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        StringBuilder nStrBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        long t = n;
        while (t > 0) {
            nStrBuilder.append((char)('0' + (t % 10)));
            t /= 10;
        }
        String nStr = nStrBuilder.reverse().toString();

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; i++) pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;
        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); len++) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < nStr.length() && firstdiff < len; firstdiff++) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; lastdig++) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0) continue;
                    if (lastdig == nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0') continue;
                    if (len == nStr.length() && lastdig > nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0') continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char)('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); pos++) {
                        char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                        for (char dig = start; dig < curstp.charAt(pos); dig++) {
                            base += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                        }
                        tmp.append(curstp.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    StringBuilder tmp2 = new StringBuilder(tmp);
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; pos++) {
                        variables.add((int)(countWithPrefix(tmp2.toString() + '0', n, nStr) % mod));
                        tmp2.append('0');
                    }

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t2 = 0; t2 < variables.size(); t2++) {
                        int idx = variables.size() - 1 - t2;
                        variables.set(idx, variables.get(idx) - (int)(pw10[t2] % mod));
                    }

                    base %= mod;
                    if (base < 0) base += mod;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); i++) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % mod;
                        if (val < 0) val += mod;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    BigInteger[] ansRef = new BigInteger[]{ans};
                    solve(variables, (int)base, ansRef);
                    ans = ansRef[0];
                }
            }
        }

        // special case: prefixes of n
        long curVal = 0;
        StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();
        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); len++) {
            curst.append(nStr.charAt(len - 1));
            curVal = 10 * curVal + (nStr.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); pos++) {
                char start = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0');
                for (char dig = start; dig < curst.charAt(pos); dig++) {
                    val += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                }
                tmp.append(curst.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;

            val -= curVal;
            val %= mod;
            if (val < 0) val += mod;

            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007));
        System.out.println(toString(ans));
    }
}
